provenance.notes: Easy-tier household organics duo (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 1, APPROVED 2026-09-26): aspirin + benzoic acid. Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human PHYSIOLOGICAL-PROTONATION decision '2 go R1-R8', 08.1-08 protonation audit rows 1-2, directive: 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): aspirin CID 2244 neutral -> acetylsalicylate CID 3434975 (-1, pKa 3.47 per PubChem AID 781325/781326; 3.38 Serjeant IUPAC) and benzoic acid CID 243 neutral -> benzoate CID 242 (-1, the 08-04-approved alternate; pKa 4.207-3.96 AID 781325-781330). Both fetched live 2026-10-05 as PubChem 3D records; heavy atoms unchanged (13/9), one carboxyl H removed each; easy-1 GAINS its first salt-bridge-capable ligands (bona-fide carboxylates).

Aspirin as acetylsalicylate, PubChem CID 3434975 (C9H7O4-, 13 heavy, Charge -1 as recorded; ester intact). Complex: 1OXR phospholipase A2-aspirin.Ca2+ complex (AIN in nonpolymer inventory, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI human-verified via PDB website). Carries salt_bridge (bona-fide carboxylate -1 - the physiological anion), h_bond (ester + carboxylate O acceptors, no acidic donor), pi_stacking (benzene), hydrophobic, cation_pi (AA-cation-over-ring). 1OXR's crystallographic Ca is the cleanup-scene real-world analog (Decision 7). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8', audit row 1/R3, directive 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): was CID 2244 neutral free acid (Charge 0, 21 atoms {1:16,2:5}); swapped to the physiological anion CID 3434975 (99.99% at pH 7.4; pKa 3.47/3.5 PubChem AID 781325/781326, 3.49 Merck, 3.38 Serjeant IUPAC serjeant4540). The prior ester-based accidental '-' typing (capability.py ester false-positive, recorded) is SUPERSEDED by this bona-fide carboxylate anion. Neutral CID 2244 record stays in git history.

Benzoate anion, PubChem CID 242 (C7H5O2-, 9 heavy, Charge -1 as recorded; the 08-04-approved charged-form alternate, now the shipped form). Complex: 5E4D hydroxynitrile lyase-benzoic acid (BEZ in inventory, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI resolves 200). Carries salt_bridge (carboxylate -1 - easy tier's first bona-fide anion beside acetate), h_bond (carboxylate O acceptors, no donor), pi_stacking (benzene), hydrophobic, cation_pi (AA-cation-over-ring). Smallest aromatic (9 heavy) keeps easy grids dense. AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8', audit row 2/R2, directive 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): was CID 243 neutral free acid (Charge 0 as registered per C3, 15 atoms {1:11,2:4}); swapped to benzoate (-1, 99.94% at pH 7.4; pKa 4.207-3.96 AID 781325-781330, 4.19 LIDE, 4.204 CRC). Neutral CID 243 record stays in git history.
